welcome.tagline: Surprise bags from the bakeries, cafés and restaurants in your neighborhood, at the end of the day.
welcome.step1: Places in your neighborhood post surprise bags
welcome.step2: You reserve and pay in the app
welcome.step3: You pick it up at the set time

account.createSubtitle: To reserve bags and save your favorite places.
account.name: Your name
account.codeSubtitle: We sent it by WhatsApp or SMS to {{phone}}.
account.resent: We sent you a new code.
account.phoneLandline: That looks like a landline. Use your mobile number to get the code.
account.phoneNotMobile: Colombian mobile numbers start with 3. Please check the number.
account.phoneUnknownPrefix: This doesn't look like a Colombian mobile number. Please check the first digits.
account.businessSubtitle: Start with the business's mobile number. You sign in with it and customers contact you on it.
account.phoneTaken: There's already an account with this number. Sign in with it.
account.phoneUnknown: There's no account with this number. Check it or create an account.

discover.title: What are you craving today?
discover.noResults: We didn't find places for that search.

map.checkoutBody: Payment isn't ready yet. This is where you'll pay in pesos with a Colombian payment method.

orders.title: Your orders
orders.cancelUntil: You can cancel until {{time}}; we refund {{refund}}.
orders.cancelClosed: You can no longer cancel this order: the pickup window started at {{time}}.
orders.noShowRule: If you don't pick it up before they close ({{time}}), there's no refund.
orders.noPast: Your past orders will show here.

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.intro: Turn on the bell and we'll let you know as soon as your favorite place posts bags.
favorites.empty: You don't have any favorite places yet.

profile.usdNote: Prices are shown in dollars for reference. You're always charged in Colombian pesos.
profile.signOutHint: Have a business? Log out and sign in with your business account.

business.comingSoon: This screen is on its way.

today.welcomeBody: You're one step away from your first orders.
today.notReceiving: Off: customers see you're not offering bags today

bags.title: Your bags
bags.tip: Tip: enter the real value of what goes in the bag and set the price at about a third. Customers find out what's inside when they pick it up.
bags.empty: You don't have any bags yet. Create your first one and it goes live today.

pickups.title: Pickups
pickups.subtitle: Today · {{window}} · {{waiting}} of {{total}} left
pickups.scanHint: Fastest: point the camera and it's done
pickups.typeHint: Confirms by itself when you type the last digit.
pickups.confirmCancel: Cancel {{name}}'s order? The bag goes back on sale.

profile.title: Your business
profile.signOutHint: To use the app as a customer, log out and sign in with a customer account.
profile.more: Coming soon: payout account and more settings.

scanner.title: Scan the customer's code
scanner.hint: Point at the QR code on the customer's phone. It confirms by itself, nothing else to tap.
scanner.permissionBody: To scan the customer's code when you hand over their bag.
scanner.noCamera: The camera isn't available here. Type the customer's code.

handedOver.title: Handed over
handedOver.paid: Already paid in the app. Don't charge anything.
handedOver.noneLeft: Everything for today is handed over

codeError.title: This code doesn't match
codeError.scannedOther: The scanned code isn't a Ñapita order.
codeError.reasonOtherDay: The order is for another day
codeError.reasonOtherBusiness: The order is for another business
codeError.askCustomer: Ask the customer to open their order in the app and try again.
codeError.alreadyTitle: This order was already handed over
codeError.alreadyBody: {{name}} already picked up their bag today. Nothing else to hand over.
codeError.noShowBody: {{name}} didn't come during their pickup window, so it can't be handed over any more.

newBag.title: New bag
newBag.typeSubtitle: Pick the closest match. The exact contents are a surprise.
newBag.nameHint: We wrote it for you. You can change it.
newBag.priceTitle: What are the bag's contents worth?
newBag.priceSubtitle: What they'd cost in your shop at the usual price.
newBag.valueLabel: Value of the contents in pesos
newBag.priceHint: About a third of the value, so bags get reserved quickly.
newBag.quantityHint: Only the ones you're sure you'll have
newBag.repeatHint: So you don't need to open the app every day
newBag.publishedBody: Customers near you can reserve it now. We'll let you know about every reservation.
newBag.shareMessage: {{name}} today at {{business}}! Reserve yours on {{app}}: {{price}}, pick up {{from}}–{{to}}.
newBag.photosHint: Show an example of what usually goes in. If you don't add photos, we show your business's logo.
newBag.photosHintNoLogo: Show an example of what usually goes in. If you don't add photos, we show your business's name; you can also add your logo in Negocio.

signup.heading: Register your business
signup.detailsSubtitle: This is how customers find you. It takes less than 2 minutes.
signup.name: Business name
signup.typeLabel: What kind of business is it?
signup.phoneHint: The number you created the account with. Customers see it to contact you.
signup.hoursTitle: When are you open, and when can people pick up?
signup.hoursSubtitle: Pickup is usually the last hour before closing. You can change it for each bag later.
signup.tooShort: Closing must be at least one hour after opening.
signup.closesHint: Orders not picked up by {{time}} count as not collected.
signup.paymentsLater: You add payment details later, before your first sale. You don't need them now.
signup.logoHint: Customers see it on your bags when they have no photo.
